entries.raw: §cOh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!
entries.text: Oh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!
entries.zh: 糟糕! 看来你没赶上矿车!

entries.raw: §fEver been in one of these before? No?
entries.text: Ever been in one of these before? No?
entries.zh: 以前坐过这玩意儿吗?没有?
我相信你肯定没问题的!

entries.raw: §fLast guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out he might have left a surprise in there.
entries.text: Last guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out he might have left a surprise in there.
entries.zh: 上一个坐这辆车的人下来时脸色不太好,你小心点,他八成在里面留了点“惊喜”。

entries.text: Quickly now the Minecart is leaving!

entries.raw: §fOff to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...
entries.text: Off to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...
entries.zh: 去朝廷那边?我本想让你去找国王聊聊的,可我现在也不知道国王到底是谁了……

entries.raw: §fDid you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!
entries.text: Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!
entries.zh: 你知道吗,朝廷那地方差不多和王座厅一样古老,那儿的花圃也很漂亮!

entries.raw: §fSee those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.
entries.text: See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.
entries.zh: 看见那些雕像了吗?那是两位先王,Bunumir Ironbeard 和 Skordous Pebblebeard,守着矿山的入口。

entries.raw: §fAristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.
entries.text: Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.
entries.zh: 去贵族通道啊?那祝你好运了。

entries.raw: §fDid you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.
entries.text: Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.
entries.zh: 你知道吗,熔炉大到必须设好几个锻造台才够用。

entries.raw: §fYou ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.
entries.text: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.
entries.zh: 你见过那些哥布林吗?有人说它们会下蛋。真是怪事。

entries.raw: §fGoblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...
entries.text: Goblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...
entries.zh: 住在这儿的可不止哥布林。传闻这一带还游荡着泥土怪……

entries.raw: §fI once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!
entries.text: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!
entries.zh: 我有一次误打误撞找到了这一带一个隐秘的湖,结果住在那儿的几个不三不四的家伙把我的金子抢了个精光!

entries.raw: §fYou came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!
entries.text: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!
entries.zh: 你是坐升降梯下来的?我从没想过还能下到这么深! 这地方真该叫“更深层洞穴”才对!

entries.raw: §fHey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.
entries.text: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.
entries.zh: 嘿,你在下面要是找到钛就告诉我一声! 我想买点回来打把新镐子。
